localChanges: chore: lock the engine packages that double Wonder and spaceship part prices and stop unit purchases in disorder

log: The Spend rules now price purchases as v474.05 does (CityWorker.cs, the BUY branch), with r the shields left:
a unit costs floor(r² / 20) + 2r, so a part-built unit no longer costs a fraction of a coin;
a Wonder, or a spaceship Part, costs 4r. Wonders were priced like improvements, and spaceship parts had no price at all, so they couldn't be bought;
every price doubles while the city has no shields stored.

A city in CivilDisorder gets no price for a unit, so it can't buy one. It can still buy an improvement or a Wonder (v474.05 refuses those too, but the AI's disorder recovery buys a Temple through the treasury).
getRules() now takes the RuleRegistry, for the CivilDisorder check.
A unit in a city in civil disorder now has no price, and core-treasury before 0.1.8 throws from buy() when there's none.
style: prettier 2.8.8's parentheses on an array-of-typeof cast
test: describe the single floored multiplier in Isaac Newton's College's Library and University case

PlayerTreasury.buy() read spendCost.value() without checking that a Spend rule priced the build in the treasury's yield, so buying something with no price (a unit in a city in civil disorder, from a stale city screen) threw. It now returns without spending.
